name: Rubescent-Apse
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, massive canyon systems emerge like the bones of the planet.
Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
There is money in rare flora, titanium and silicon and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
